clips.title: The story
paras: Goldshire sits where Elwynn’s roads meet, linking Stormwind City with Westfall, Redridge, and the southern frontier. Rebuilt after the First War, the town now offers travelers the Lion’s Pride Inn, while a hard-pressed Stormwind Guard defends it.

Goldshire stands where the king’s highways meet, the civic and commercial heart of rural Elwynn. Threats press closer as Stormwind’s forces stretch thin and King Varian Wrynn remains mysteriously absent. Marshal Dughan relies on passing adventurers instead of regular troops to hold the surrounding borders. Riverpaw gnolls push in from the west, while hostile murlocs claim the shores of Stone Cairn Lake and Crystal Lake. Their attacks have killed royal guards and brought danger close to the town center.

Goldshire and Moonbrook were the last strongholds to fall in the First War. Warchief Blackhand cut King Llane Wrynn I off from his realm before sacking Stormwind Keep, and the Orcish Horde overwhelmed both towns. Goldshire was reduced to ash and lay barren until its rebuilding after the Second War.
